title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10
lineage: Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x2) > EAC > FLAC (tracking with CDWAV)

ai_review.summary: Excellent close‑stage matrix recording of a high‑energy Iowa show highlighted by stellar versions of Eyes of the World and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The crowd‑close recording captures a clear blend of PA and on‑stage sound, delivering an almost studio‑like clarity that lets the band’s energy shine through. Reviewers rave about the punchy tempo on “Eyes of the World,” the emotive delivery of “Stella Blue,” and the fire in early‑set numbers like “Stagger Lee” and “Bertha.” Overall the performance is described as a veteran, high‑octane set that belongs in any Deadhead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are overwhelmingly positive (3×5★, 1×4★) and praise both the musical performance and the recording quality; the consistency across multiple detailed comments yields a strong confidence in a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very close to stage, captures an interesting mix of PA and on‑stage sound; reviewers note crispness and clarity with no major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy first set with tight, upbeat numbers; the show maintains momentum throughout and feels like a seasoned, veteran performance.
